built_from: dataset/releases/v0.1.2 (MASTER + samples) + locally present expression files + HGNC reference + GEO platform annotations
canonical_coordinate: HGNC approved gene symbol; one row per native feature, and the native identifier is never overwritten

reference.hgnc_note: the 16.9 MB hgnc_complete_set.txt reference is not committed; it is re-downloaded from hgnc_origin and checked against this digest

core_entry_rule: a source enters the core gene space when >= 50% of its raw native features resolve to exactly one canonical gene, or when >= 50% of its gene-addressable features do and a foreign identifier namespace explains >=90% of its unmapped rows; both fractions are reported for every source and no native row is ever deleted

coverage_denominators.raw_mapping_fraction: mapped native features / all native features of the published matrix, as it stands
coverage_denominators.gene_addressable_mapping_fraction: mapped features / features whose native identifier belongs to a class represented in the HGNC gene namespace; a class leaves the denominator only on measured namespace evidence, never because it failed to map
coverage_denominators.entry_rule: entry needs >= 50% of raw features mapped, or >= 50% of gene-addressable features mapped when a foreign identifier namespace explains >=90% of the unmapped rows
coverage_denominators.anti_circularity: both denominators are reported for every source, and every native row stays in its feature map with its identifier class recorded

legacy_noncoding_assembly_id.identifier_shape: NONHSAG plus digits: a legacy non-coding assembly gene naming scheme

sequence_record_accession.identifier_shape: a GenBank-style sequence record accession with an optional version suffix

clone_based_temporary_name.identifier_shape: a clone-based temporary gene name carrying a dotted version suffix

retired_locuslink_id.identifier_shape: LOC plus digits: a retired NCBI locus-link identifier that denotes a gene

spreadsheet_corrupted_symbol.identifier_shape: a month-name token produced by spreadsheet date coercion of a gene symbol

transcript_identifier.identifier_shape: an Ensembl transcript or protein accession rather than a gene identifier

unannotated_array_feature.identifier_shape: an array feature whose platform annotation carries no gene assignment

adjudication.note: a foreign identifier namespace excuses a low raw fraction only when it accounts for >=90% of the unmapped rows; missing platform annotation does not, so an array whose probes were never assigned genes stays out

low_coverage.policy: no source is hidden: every source keeps its full feature map and contributes to the union, and both denominators are reported side by side

verdicts.GSE3578_array: raw coverage 23841/54359 features (43.9%) carry an HGNC gene. 28807 features are probe ids whose platform annotation carries no gene symbol and no gene id; they stay inside the gene-addressable denominator because the missing information is the platform annotation, not a foreign identifier namespace.
verdicts.MGH_GSE115821_bulk: raw coverage 21021/75253 features (27.9%) carry an HGNC gene. gene-addressable coverage 21020/21181 (99.2%) once non-gene-namespace classes are removed from the denominator: 54072 features are named by the legacy_noncoding_assembly_id scheme, of whose 54072 distinct tokens only 1 appear anywhere in the HGNC namespace.
verdicts.MGH_GSE168204_bulk: raw coverage 21048/75253 features (28.0%) carry an HGNC gene. gene-addressable coverage 21047/21181 (99.4%) once non-gene-namespace classes are removed from the denominator: 54072 features are named by the legacy_noncoding_assembly_id scheme, of whose 54072 distinct tokens only 1 appear anywhere in the HGNC namespace.

explicit_non_goals: expression values are NOT placed on one numerical scale here: the canonical gene space answers which biological feature a column represents, not whether the measured values are comparable
no global normalization or ComBat across cohorts
no within-cohort normalization (Level C), no rank representation (Level D), no paired delta representation (Level E)
ambiguous features are recorded with all candidate genes, never assigned to one by majority vote, expression correlation or genomic proximity

sample-level binding of a MASTER sample id to a matrix column is not asserted here; a pair enters the canonical gene space when both endpoint references resolve to the same core-rule expression source
GSE319641 features are already author-ComBat-corrected TPMs, so that source carries another laboratory batch correction before any PAIR-side representation
no expression matrices are committed; only feature-to-gene mappings
